chromeos-cr50-scripts: cr50 event log tracking script The new script is invoked once after startup. First the script updates the Cr50 flash log time base, so that new events would be reported with the correct time stamp. The time stamp of the most recent reported event is saved in /mnt/stateful_partition/unencrypted/preserve/cr50_flog_timestamp which makes sure that it survives powerwashes, OS updates, etc. If the file does not exist, it is created with the value of time stamp of 0. The script polls the Cr50 to retrieve log entries added after the most recent reported one. If there are such entries, their timestamp is saved and the event ID is added to the sparse UMA histogram Platform.Cr50.FlashLog, and after successful addition the time stamp is saved as the BRANCH=none BUG=b:132287488 TEST=generated a few log entries using Cr50 console command and ran the script. Observed the entries showing up in chrome://histograms and verified that the timestamps are matching real time. Verified that there are no duplicate histogram updates when this script is re-ran, and that new events show up in the histogram if they are added on the Cr50. Verified that when running on a DUT with Cr50 version not yet supporting flash log, cr50-metrics.conf still completes successfully. Change-Id: Iae47fe015e0fb41f6ff165f4db9f5bdbe53c1bfc Signed-off-by: Vadim Bendebury <vbendeb@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1649196 Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Namyoon Woo <namyoon@chromium.org>

FIXUP: FROMLIST: ASoC: SOF: Add Sound Open Firmware driver core If CONFIG_SND_SOC_SOF=y and CONFIG_SND_SOC_SOF_NOCODEC=m, builds fail with ld: sound/soc/sof/core.o: in function `sof_machine_check': >> sound/soc/sof/core.c:269: undefined reference to `sof_nocodec_setup' ld: sound/soc/sof/sof-acpi-dev.o: in function `sof_acpi_probe': >> sound/soc/sof/sof-acpi-dev.c:220: undefined reference to `sof_nocodec_setup' This happens because sof_nocodec_setup() is called from code built into the kernel but resides in a module. Since sof_nocodec_setup() is called unconditionally from the SOF core, SND_SOC_SOF_NOCODEC must be enabled if SND_SOC_SOF is enabled. This means that SND_SOC_SOF_OPTIONS must be enabled as well. FROMLIST: shellcheck: Add support for shflags Upstream PR at https://github.com/koalaman/shellcheck/pull/1604. This adds a new --uses-shflags option to shellcheck that makes it recognize DEFINE_string et al. as variable creation sites. Now shellcheck will not claim that the resulting FLAGS_nnn variables are referenced without assignment. As a bonus, it will also warn about command-line arguments that are defined and never referenced.
